meta.title: Ideas box
meta.description: Suggest an idea to improve Godet, the maintenance log for construction machinery, and follow the team’s replies.

title: Let’s improve Godet together
lead: Missing a feature, or bothered by a detail in your daily work? Describe your idea. We read every suggestion and tell you what we do with it.

how.title: How it works
how.send: You describe your idea, in one sentence or in detail.
how.review: The team reviews it and gives it a status: under review, planned, done or declined, with a reply where needed.
how.follow: When you are signed in, you can follow your ideas and our replies on this page.

form.title: Your idea
form.ideaTitleHint: For example: “Read the hour meter with my phone’s camera”.
form.detailsHint: The situation on site, the problem you ran into, what would help… 4000 characters maximum.
form.emailHint: So that we can reply. Have an account? <link>Sign in</link> to follow your ideas.
form.signedInAs: Signed in as {email}: your idea will be linked to your account.
form.privacy: Your data is used to handle your idea. See our <link>privacy policy</link>.

sent.title: Thank you for your idea!
sent.text: It has reached us. We will review it and reply by email if needed.
sent.textSignedIn: It has reached us and now appears under “My ideas”, where you will see our replies.

mine.title: My ideas
mine.count: {count, plural, =0 {No ideas yet} one {# idea} other {# ideas}}
mine.empty: You have not suggested any ideas yet. The first one may well be the best!
mine.loadError: Your ideas could not be loaded. Please reload the page.
mine.anonymous: <link>Sign in</link> to see your ideas and the team’s replies.

errors.titleShort: Describe your idea in a few words (at least 3 characters).
errors.emailRequired: Please enter your email address so that we can reply.
errors.rateLimited: You have already sent a lot of ideas today: thank you! Please try again tomorrow.
errors.busy: The service is very busy. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.generic: The idea could not be sent. Please try again in a moment.
